$\text { and } \quad \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} =-\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}$

$\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=0+P(x)=-2 x$

$\therefore f(x)=-x^{2}+ \text{constant}$

$\therefore \quad v=y^{2}-x^{2}+ \text{constant}$

Therefore, the correct answer is **C**.

detailed_solution.markdown: Given data: $$\begin{aligned} c_{c}=4178 \mathrm{J} / \mathrm{kgK} ; c_{h}&=2130 \mathrm{J} / \mathrm{kgK} \\ m_{c}=1.5 \mathrm{kg} / \mathrm{s} ; m_{h}&=1 \mathrm{kg} / \mathrm{s} \\ C_{\min }=& c_{h} m_{h}=2130 \times 1=2130 \mathrm{W} / \mathrm{k} \\ C_{\max }=& c_{c} m_{c}=4178 \times 1.5 \\ =& 6267 \mathrm{W} / \mathrm{K} \\ \Delta T_{1}=& 100-42=58^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \\ \Delta T_{2}=& 50-25=25^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \\ \Delta T_{l m} =&\frac{\Delta T_{1}-\Delta T_{2}}{\ln \left(\frac{\Delta T_{1}}{\Delta T_{2}}\right)} \\ =& \ln \left(\frac{58}{25}\right)=39.21^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \\ Q=& \mathrm{UA} \Delta T_{\mathrm{Im}} \\ \text{ also}\quad Q=& m_{c} c_{\mathrm{c}}\left(T_{\mathrm{c} 2}-T_{\mathrm{c} 1}\right) \\ \therefore \quad UA \Delta T_{l m}=&m_{c} c_{c}\left(T_{c 2}-T_{c 1}\right) \\ U A =&\frac{4178 \times 1.5(42-25)}{39.21} \\ =&2717.138 \mathrm{W} / \mathrm{K} \end{aligned}$$ $$\begin{aligned} \mathrm{NTU} &=\frac{\mathrm{UA}}{\mathrm{C}_{\min }}=\frac{2717}{2130}=1.2756 \\ C &=\frac{C_{\min }}{C_{\max }}=\frac{2130}{6267}=0.34 \\ &=\frac{1-\exp [-N T U(1-C)]}{1-C \exp [-N T U(1-C)]} \\ &=\frac{1-\exp [-1.2756 \times 0.66]}{1-0.34 \exp [1-2756 \times 0.66]} \\ &=\frac{1-0.43}{1-0.34 \times 0.43}=0.6676\\ Alternatively:\\ \epsilon &=\frac{T_{h_{1}}-T_{h_{2}}}{T_{h_{1}}-T_{c_{1}}} \\ &=\frac{100-50}{100-25} \\ &=\frac{50}{75}=\frac{2}{3}=0.6667 \end{aligned}$$ Therefore, the correct answer is **0.66** (acceptable range: [0.65, 0.67]).

The hole is made by punching process. Neglecting the effect of clearance, the punching force (in kN) is (

detailed_solution.markdown: $$\begin{aligned} \text { Shear area } &=P \times t \\ &=2(100+50) \times 5=1500 \mathrm{mm}^{2} \end{aligned}$$ Punching force: $$\begin{aligned} F &=\tau \times A_{s}=300 \times 1500 \\ &=450 \times 10^{ 3} \mathrm{N}=450 \mathrm{kN} \end{aligned}$$ Therefore, the correct answer is **B**.
